transcript.text: Hi everyone! I'm excited to get our family telescope evening planned for this summer. As the Telescope Keeper, I'll be putting together the final plan — date, location, viewing setup, and transportation. Before we commit to anything, let's make sure we sort out all the practical details together: any reservations we might need, transportation constraints, and equipment needs. One important thing to note upfront: the evening will start with a brief solar viewing segment before dark, so the telescope's certified solar safety filter needs to be attached before anyone looks through it. After that, we'll continue with dark-sky observation. So, let's start figuring out what works for everyone — what dates are people available this summer, and does anyone have transportation constraints or location preferences I should know about?
